name: The Landings St. Lucia
insider_take: This ultra-luxe resort sits on a stunning 19-acre peninsula where the Caribbean Sea meets the Atlantic, offering the rare privilege of watching both sunrise and sunset over water from the same location.
whats_special: The Landings features the largest yacht marina in St. Lucia, accommodating vessels up to 120 feet. The resort's unique position on Pigeon Point Peninsula means you're surrounded by water on three sides, with direct access to both calm bay waters and open ocean. Each villa comes with its own private pool and many include boat slips right at your doorstep.
pro_tip: Book a villa on the marina side during whale watching season (January-April) – humpback whales frequently pass through the deep channel just offshore, visible from your private terrace.
dont_miss: The weekly Friday night jump-up at nearby Gros Islet village, where the entire fishing village transforms into a vibrant street party with local cuisine, rum punch, and live Caribbean music. The resort's complimentary shuttle makes it an easy 5-minute journey to experience authentic St. Lucian culture.
pros: Spacious villa-style accommodations with full kitchens and private terraces
Direct beachfront location on pristine Rodney Bay with calm waters
Multiple dining options including beachside and fine dining restaurants
Comprehensive resort amenities with spa, marina, and water sports
cons: Remote location requires transportation for exploring other areas
